preconditions.description: K is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(P) == K and all(1 <= x <= K for x in P) and len(set(P)) == K
preconditions.description: P is a permutation of K distinct integers each between 1 and K inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(M) == K and all(len(M[i]) == K for i in range(K)) and all(M[i][j] in ['Y', 'N'] for i in range(K) for j in range(K))
preconditions.description: M is a KxK matrix where each element is either 'Y' or 'N'.

postconditions.expression: len(result) == K and all(1 <= x <= K for x in result) and len(set(result)) == K
postconditions.description: result is a permutation of K distinct integers each between 1 and K inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(all(result[i] <= result[j] for j in range(i + 1, K)) for i in range(K - 1))
postconditions.description: result is the lexicographically smallest permutation that can be obtained from P by exchanging elements according to M.
